Hi Sanjay / Maya —

Thanks again for the time last week. Per our conversation, I put together a short Mutual Action Plan (attached) so we can align on milestones, owners, and a realistic close cadence for the StratusTech evaluation. Goal here is to make responsibilities explicit so your team has a clear evaluation path and Redwood can support technical gating items.

High-level plan (timeline: 6 weeks target to evaluation completion):
- Week 0 (this week): MAP kickoff, stakeholder alignment, access checklist
- Week 1: Data ingestion + baseline generation (SE + Stratus Eng)
- Week 2: Latency / cost baseline & model knobs (SE + ML Eng)
- Week 3: Feature validation + integration proofs (Stratus Eng lead)
- Week 4: Security + compliance checklist (pulled in by procurement/legal)
- Week 5: Final evaluation run, quality sign-off, and next-step commercial discussion

Proposed owners (please confirm or suggest alternates):
- Redwood AE (primary): Ben Carter
- Redwood Solutions Engineer (technical lead): Stephanie Nguyen
- Redwood ML Engineer (model evaluation, metrics): Vivek Kulkarni
- StratusTech Eng Lead (integration & infra): Sanjay Rao
- StratusTech PM (acceptance & success criteria): Maya Patel
- StratusTech Procurement: procurement@stratustech.com

Attachments included: StratusTech_MAP_v0.2.xlsx (proposed dates and deliverables), eval-checklist.pdf (technical gating list).

Requests / asks for the kickoff:
1) Can Sanjay confirm the engineering lead who will be hands-on for data ingestion and the preferred VPN / staging environment (AWS account, VPC peering, or S3 presigned)?
2) Can Maya share the top 5 success criteria (quality thresholds) you’ll use for go/no-go on the pilot?
3) Please confirm availability for a 60-minute kickoff this week — we have windows Wed 10:00-11:30 PT or Thu 14:00-15:30 PT.

If that schedule or owners don’t fit, tell me and I’ll update the MAP. Stephanie and Vivek are looped for the technical details below.

Thanks — looking forward to getting the MAP locked and running.

Thanks Ben — looping in a short technical kickoff agenda so the meeting is productive. Sanjay, quick intro — I’m Stephanie (Solutions Engineer) and I’ll drive the integration and baseline runs. Vivek will own metrics & model eval.

Proposed 60-minute kickoff agenda (we’ll tailor on the call):
- 0-10m: Intros & success criteria (Maya)
- 10-25m: Architecture & access plan (Sanjay + Redwood SE)
- 25-40m: Data expectations & ingestion workflow (format, sample size, PII handling)
- 40-50m: Evaluation plan overview (metrics, baselines, logging)
- 50-60m: Action items & immediate next steps (who does what this week)

Answers to the questions Sanjay raised:
- Preferred dataset format: ndjson or parquet. If you already have a CSV export it’s workable but ndjson/parquet preserves schema and is easier for our tooling.
- For the baseline we’d like: 500-2,000 representative records (anonymized) and a separate holdout set for validation if possible. Sample traces (request/response logs) are helpful but not required for the first pass.

Technical pre-reqs we’ll need before Week 1 baseline run:
- S3 bucket with an IAM role (read-only) or temporary presigned URLs
- A sample of ~1k anonymized records in ndjson/parquet
- If you plan to test in your VPC, a short network diagram and preferred access window

I attached the lightweight eval-checklist.pdf that lists our gating items and the minimal data we need. If procurement needs SOC 2 evidence, Laura from security will share a short summary doc — Ben, can you include that in the procurement thread?

I’ll prepare the baseline script and a short runbook to speed Week 1.

—Stephanie Nguyen
